## Introduction

Load ODM XML files as Polars DataFrames. 

Example ODM XML file <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elong0527/demo-cdisc-yaml/refs/heads/main/data/odm/car-t-openclinica.xml> 

## Setup

```{python}
import sys
import os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(".."))

import polars as pl
from src.odm import load
from reactable import Reactable, embed_css

pl.Config.set_tbl_rows(10)
embed_css()
```

## Common Schema 

- pro: output data always have common schema. 
- con: each value is a `struct`, need extra `unnest` step.

```{python}
file_path = "../data/odm/car-t-openclinica.xml"

# Load with hierarchical struct columns
df_dict = load.odm_xml_to_df_dict(file_path)
df_dict.head(5)
```

### Data Schema 

```{python}
df_dict.schema
```

## Different Schema 

```{python}
# Load flattened for analysis
df = load.odm_xml_to_df(file_path)
df.columns
```

```{python}
Reactable(df)
```

### Listing of Forms 

```{python}
pl.Config.set_tbl_cols(-1)
pl.Config.set_tbl_rows(-1)
```

```{python}
df["formoid", "formname"].unique().sort("formname")
```

### Demographic Form

```{python}
dm = df.filter(df["formoid"] == "F_1DEMOGRAPHIC")
dm_wide = dm.pivot(
    index=["subjectkey", "studyeventoid", "studyeventrepeatkey", "formoid", 'itemgroupoid', 'itemgrouprepeatkey'], values="value", 
    on="itemname"
)
Reactable(dm_wide)
```


### Randomization Form

```{python}
rand = df.filter(df["formoid"] == "F_3RANDOMIZE")
rand_wide = rand.pivot(
    index=["subjectkey", "studyeventoid", "studyeventrepeatkey", "formoid", 'itemgroupoid', 'itemgrouprepeatkey'], values="value", 
    on="itemname"
)
Reactable(rand_wide)
```

```{python}
rand = df.filter(df["formoid"] == "F_4VIEWRANDOMI")
rand_wide = rand.pivot(
    index=["subjectkey", "studyeventoid", "studyeventrepeatkey", "formoid", 'itemgroupoid', 'itemgrouprepeatkey'], values="value", 
    on="itemname"
).sort("KITALLOCATION")
Reactable(rand_wide)
```

### Disposition Form 

```{python}
ds = df.filter(df["formoid"] == "F_DISPOSITION")
ds_wide = ds.pivot(index=["subjectkey", "formoid"], values="value", on="itemname")
Reactable(ds_wide)
```

## Summary

The ODM loader provides:

- Smart naming (only duplicates get prefixes)
- Hierarchical or flattened output
- Automatic lowercase conversion
- Namespace cleaning
